name: cambell-prince/frontaccounting-simple-api
description: A simple REST API for FrontAccounting, delivered as a module

scripts.lint: find . -name vendor -prune -o -name node_modules -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.php' -o -name '*.inc' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suite. Needs a FrontAccounting install serving this module and a seeded fa_test database — docker/fa-api test does both.
scripts-descriptions.lint: php -l over every PHP and .inc file in the module.
scripts-descriptions.cs:check: Check src/ and tests/ against PSR-2 (phpcs.xml). Not yet clean, so it is deliberately not part of quality/ci; docker/fa-api lint reports it without failing.
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Fix what phpcbf can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.quality: lint, then analyze — the two static gates that are clean today.
scripts-descriptions.ci: quality, then test — the same gates GitHub Actions runs through docker/fa-api.
scripts-descriptions.docs: Regenerate swagger.json and the static docs (needs make.phar; see README).
scripts-descriptions.package: Build the release zip and tarball (needs make.phar; see README).
